analyzer_version: slither-analyzer==0.11.5 (pip-resolvable via importlib.metadata in this repo's .venv)
source_inspection_notes: Two detectors combine for full function coverage: unchecked-lowlevel (flags LowLevelCall IR -- call/delegatecall/staticcall -- whose return value is never subsequently read) and unchecked-send (same UnusedReturnValues logic, for Send IR). Together they cover all four named functions. Real gap found on reading unchecked_low_level_return_values.py: a return value ASSIGNED TO A STATE VARIABLE is treated as 'checked' even if never branched on afterward ('if a return value is stored in a state variable, it's ok', line 63-64) -- this is looser than EthTrust's text, which requires the value be checked 'to determine whether the call failed', not merely stored. A contract that stores the boolean into a state var and never reads it again would satisfy Slither's heuristic but not EthTrust's actual intent.
